text:
maria: quick heads-up — trying to onboard verdant-7b v1 to the hosted catalog. Conversion finished but config validation failed with a TP/shard mismatch and tokenizer warnings. Can people with packaging context advise?

maria: error from validator: 
```
ValidationError: tensor-parallel layout mismatch: expected num_shards=2 (tp=2) but found 4 shard files in checkpoint
TokenizationWarning: tokenizer.json missing "eos_token_id"; defaulting to None
```

maria: here's the s3 listing that conversion uploaded: 
```
s3://redwood-models/verdant/7b/v1/pack-20260312/
  pytorch_model-00001-of-00004.safetensors
  pytorch_model-00002-of-00004.safetensors
  pytorch_model-00003-of-00004.safetensors
  pytorch_model-00004-of-00004.safetensors
  tokenizer.json
  config.json
  SHA256SUMS
```

kevin: ok looks like conversion used TP=4 output naming (00004). For our serving config we pinned tp=2. Two options: re-run conversion with `--tp 2` OR repack/merge shards into 2 files.

kevin: for merging you can try the shard-reshard helper: 
```
python tools/reshard.py --from-tp 4 --to-tp 2 --in-dir ./in --out-dir ./out --pattern "pytorch_model-*.safetensors"
```

maria: thanks — are there any caveats when moving from 4->2 with fp16/bf16? validator also flagged dtype mismatch: config says `dtype: float16` but logs show bf16 tensors.

raj: note: bf16 -> fp16 conversion is lossy. If you plan to serve float16, better to convert weights with quantization-aware or cast safely. Quick command we use: 
```
python tools/convert_dtype.py --src ./in --dst ./out --from-dtype bf16 --to-dtype float16
```
This script also updates safetensors metadata so validator sees correct dtype.

sarah: tokenizer: the `tokenizer.json` exists but missing `eos_token_id`. Quick patch to config.json & tokenizer meta is fine. Example patch: 
```
# config.json
{
  "model_type": "gpt",
  "hidden_size": 4096,
  "dtype": "float16",
  "eos_token_id": 2
}
```
and ensure `tokenizer.json` contains the same ids in `special_tokens_map`.

maria: got it. I'll: 1) re-run conversion with `--tp 2 --dtype float16` 2) run `convert_dtype.py` if needed 3) add eos_token_id to config and tokenizer 4) regenerate SHA256SUMS and re-upload. Any other checks?

kevin: add checksum + manifest, please include `manifest.json` with `num_shards`, `tp_layout`, `dtype`, `vocab_files` keys so catalog ingestion can auto-validate. Example: 
```
{
  "num_shards": 2,
  "tp_layout": "tp=2",
  "dtype": "float16",
  "vocab_files": ["tokenizer.json"]
}
```

maria: noted. Will also run `safetensors inspect` to double-check dtypes: 
```
safetensors inspect pytorch_model-00001-of-00002.safetensors
# prints tensor names and dtypes
```

deploy-bot: Model validation job queued: #98721 — awaiting new artifacts at s3://redwood-models/verdant/7b/v1/pack-20260312/ (watching) :eyes:

maria: thanks. Targeting to finish conversion + uploads in next 2 hours and will ping here with results. :thumbsup:

kevin: perfect — if you hit weird naming (e.g., zero-padded vs not) let me know, our validator is picky about `-of-00002` vs `-of-2`.

sarah: also make sure the tokenizer files include `merges.txt` if it's a bpe-based one, otherwise ingestion warns.

maria: will do. pinging when done.
